name: Verify that the Home navigation link is marked as active on the dashboard.
Verify that the Habits page shows Active Habits details, weekly calendar, and Taking Medication card correctly.
Verify that the Recipe Book page shows header, tabs, and enabled Generate New Recipe button.
Verify that This Week cards for Meals, Weight, and Exercise show correct titles and progress units.
Verify that the Medication page shows date controls, tabs, Today's Log section, and Add Medication button.
Verify that weekly progress title and progress bar are visible and contain valid values.
Verify that Discussion, Recipes, Fitness Videos, and Medications are visible in the Explore section.
Verify that food logs can be deleted for current week dates across all meal sections.
Verify that the Health page displays Weight, Exercise, Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, Electrodermal Activity, Tobacco Count, and HbA1c cards.
Verify that the notification panel opens, shows Mark All as Read, and contains notifications with message text.
Verify that the Fitness Videos page shows header, categories, and video items with required details.
Verify that existing Weight logs are listed correctly and can be deleted successfully.
Verify that the discussion dropdown shows Talk to My Coach, Talk to My Team, and View My Meetings.
Verify that the dashboard header shows the logo, discussion icon, notification icon, and profile menu.
Verify that Exercise progress updates correctly toward weekly target when exercise entries are added.
Verify that Home, Food, Health, Learn or Videos, and Habits links are visible in the main navigation.
Verify that the Food page shows date controls, calorie and macro sections, meal cards, and Logs section.
Verify that clicking the Weight Loss arrow on Home opens the Health page.
Verify that existing Exercise logs are listed correctly and can be deleted successfully.
Verify that Set Targets page loads and allows counter changes, unit toggle updates, and save action.
Verify that the notification badge is either not shown or shows a valid non-negative count.
Verify that the Weight Loss Progress card shows correct labels, values, units, percentage, and Set Targets button.
Verify that the personalized welcome message is displayed with the expected text.
Verify that updated target values are saved and reflected on Home cards after refresh.
Verify that Meals progress updates correctly when food is added across current-week days.
Verify that the profile dropdown contains all expected menu options.
Verify that the Discussion page shows tabs, post composer controls, and feed item details.
Verify that Weight progress updates correctly when weight logs are added across current-week days.
Verify that the available Learn or Videos page opens and shows required sections and content.
Verify that Weight Loss Progress card and related values update after adding a new weight entry.
